headline: Council approved taking easements for and accepting portions of Millbrook Road as a public way; public hearings set for Woodbury and Dane Streets.
summary: Members of the public spoke on sewer billing and Flock camera use. The council approved the Millbrook Road orders, a waiver on an affordable housing unit, a license renewal, a reappointment, and two public hearings for November 23rd.
decisions: Council accepted the original Millbrook Road order 223, 8-0.
Approved taking of easements in portions of Millbrook Road, 8-0.
Approved adopting the layout and accepting portions of Millbrook Road as a public way, 8-0.
Approved the waiver of first refusal on the affordable housing unit at 348 Rantoul Street, unit 202, 8-0.
Granted the 2027 class two motor vehicle license renewal for Michael's Auto Body of Beverly, 8-0.
Approved the reappointment of Peter Daphko as Constable, 8-0.
Approved setting a 7:30 public hearing on November 23rd for underground facilities on Woodbury Street, 8-0.
Approved setting a 7:40 public hearing on November 23rd for underground facilities on Dane Street, 8-0.
discussion: Sewer billing method: A speaker argued that Beverly's sewer charges based on water use may conflict with state law and asked the council to consider changing them.
Flock camera contracts: A speaker urged the council to end the city's Flock contract, citing data sharing, contract terms, and legal risk.
Millbrook Road order numbering: Members discussed how to split order 264 into two votes so both could be taken tonight.
